mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cinesquare (category_id, title, content, author_id, created_at, views) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{authorId}, NOW(), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT cs.post_id AS postId, cs.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, cs.title AS title, cs.content AS content, cs.views AS views, cs.created_at AS createdAt, cs.author_id AS authorId FROM cinesquare cs JOIN category c ON cs.category_id = c.category_id WHERE cs.post_id = #{postId}

SELECT cs.post_id AS postId, cs.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, cs.title AS title, cs.content AS content, cs.views AS views, cs.created_at AS createdAt, cs.author_id AS authorId FROM cinesquare cs JOIN category c ON cs.category_id = c.category_id WHERE cs.category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY cs.created_at DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cinesquare WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND author_id = #{authorId}
